content:
Alex V: Tiny but important copy/a11y callout for alert preview. we currently say 'This alert will notify X, Y' — some folks prefer 'will route to' because it maps to runtime routing semantics. Mei H: I prefer 'will notify' for end-user clarity. 'route to' sounds infra-y. but we do need to call out that order is dispatch order, not configured priority. Jordan K: Accessibility: should aria-live be polite or assertive? assertive will interrupt SR users mid-sentence if they are in the console. that could be jarring. Priyanka R: Agree — start with polite. if an admin explicitly opens the preview (keyboard focus lands there) we can also fire a short role=status readout. assertive only for critical incidents where user expects immediate interruption. Alex V: Good nuance. proposed copy for polite region: 'This alert will notify PagerDuty, then Slack, then Email. Suppressed: Ops-email until 2:14pm.' keep it one line. Mei H: Also debate about punctuation: 'then' vs commas. 'PagerDuty, then Slack, then Email' reads better to SRs. Jordan K: Small implementation detail: don't use CSS order changes. DOM order must match visual order. otherwise NVDA/VoiceOver behave differently. Priyanka R: Mobile / narrow screens: preview collapses into a single-line summary. ensure the expand button has aria-expanded and a visible affordance for suppressed channels. assist-bot: FYI design note created: https://go/redwood/ux/issue/4987 - preview copy and aria-live policy. feature-flag required for rollout. Alex V: API ask: include 'preview_snapshot' payload so frontend doesn't re-sort and can surface exact dispatch reason. include human-friendly suppressed_until_relative. Mei H: Also add a tiny 'Why this wording?' tooltip pointing to a short doc: 'We use "notify" for clarity; dispatch order may differ from configured priority.' Jordan K: Reused aria snippet to land on when preview opens: ```
This alert will notify PagerDuty, then Slack, then Email. Suppressed: Ops-email for 2h 12m.
``` Priyanka R: Final nit: announce counts first for quick scanning: 'This alert will notify 2 channels: PagerDuty, then Slack.' helps SR users who want summary counts. Alex V: Nice. i'll update the mock with the 'notify' language, polite aria-live, and a collapsed mobile variant. tagging @Mei H and @Jordan K for quick thumbs. :white_check_mark:
